title: A Lean 4 Formalization of Scott's Measurement Structures and Linear Inequalities (1964)
description: Machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of Dana Scott's 1964 paper Measurement Structures and Linear Inequalities (Journal of Mathematical Psychology 1 (1964), 233-247). Dana Scott was not contacted and did not participate in, review, or endorse this formalization. Primary readable artifact: arxiv.pdf (when published). Source repository: https://github.com/catskillsresearch/scott1964.
notes: Software and Lean sources are Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). Scott's source PDF in sources/ is not Apache-2.0 (see NOTICE). Readable paper PDF is arxiv.pdf in this deposit when present. Prepared with LLM assistance; all Lean proofs are machine-checked.
